nodes.label: Anviq API Service
nodes.rationale: Long-running always-on API process; serverless request handlers are insufficient. Does not receive an unrestricted Docker socket.

nodes.label: Docker Computer
nodes.rationale: Sibling containers running Xvfb, window manager, and Chromium on per-bot networks with memory/CPU/PID ceilings.

nodes.label: E2B Sandbox Provider
nodes.rationale: Runs bot computers away from the Anviq Agents host for public/multi-user production deployments; checkpoints portable workspace and browser profile to DATA_DIR.

nodes.label: Encrypted & Off-Site Backups (age & rclone)
nodes.rationale: Streams pg_dump and tar directly into age public-key encryption so plaintext never touches disk and the server cannot read its own backups.

nodes.label: Graphile Worker
nodes.rationale: Always-on background job worker using graphile_worker Postgres tables; jobs run scoped to their row's Space and user or runAsSystem.

nodes.label: Local Computer Access Bridge
nodes.rationale: Authenticated bridge from app-managed Docker backend to Electron so bots run commands under the local OS user without exposing remote instances or container hosts.

nodes.label: Messaging Platforms (Slack, Telegram, Feishu/Lark, iMessage, WhatsApp)
nodes.norm_label: messaging platforms (slack, telegram, feishu/lark, imessage, whatsapp)

nodes.label: OpenID Connect SSO
nodes.rationale: Optional OIDC authentication with PKCE, JWKS verification, explicit account linking, and prompt=login/max_age=0 reauthentication for account deletion.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database
nodes.rationale: Stays on the internal Compose network only (not published on a public interface); Postgres 18 is used in prod/source Compose while images Compose stays on Postgres 16.

nodes.label: Production Single-VM Deployment
nodes.rationale: Runs hosted product with Postgres, API, worker, web, and Caddy automatic HTTPS; defaults to E2B so the VM exposes no Docker supervisor unless prod.docker.yml overlay is layered.

nodes.label: Published Images Deployment
nodes.rationale: No-checkout deployment via install-images.sh and docker-compose.images.yml using multi-arch GHCR images.

nodes.label: Sandbox Supervisor
nodes.rationale: Runs from the app image on the internal network only (no host port) and holds the Docker socket so the API process does not get unrestricted Docker host access.

nodes.label: Updater Sidecar
nodes.rationale: Separate container with its own image/tag on a private control network so an update never recreates the process performing it, and the API never holds the Docker socket or ANVIQ_UPDATER_TOKEN.

nodes.label: Web App (Vite Preview)
nodes.rationale: Same-origin proxies /api and /rpc and hosts the authenticated browser-screen proxy.

nodes.label: Web Search Providers (Keyless HTTP, Parallel, Keenable)
nodes.norm_label: web search providers (keyless http, parallel, keenable)

nodes.label: Database Roles & Row-Level Security
nodes.rationale: Separates the migration owner login from the non-superuser anviq_app login so API and worker cannot bypass row-level security; system tasks use runAsSystem keyed by the app password.

nodes.label: Restricted Computer Egress
nodes.rationale: Uses deterministic anviq-c* bridge names and host iptables rules (DOCKER-USER and INPUT) to allow public internet while blocking the Docker host, LAN, and cloud metadata 169.254.169.254.

nodes.norm_label: bot homes & artifacts in object storage
nodes.rationale: Stores server-encrypted bot homes and artifacts in an S3-compatible bucket so DATA_DIR is only a cache and multi-replica API/worker hosts need no shared disk.

nodes.label: Content Encryption at Rest
nodes.rationale: Encrypts chat messages, memory, instructions, and files under keys derived from ENCRYPTION_KEY before reaching Postgres or DATA_DIR so database/volume backups cannot be read without the key.
